name: ProseColumns - Single Section
description: The one-section shape: prose centred to a readable measure with a harmonograph in a lane to its left and a Voronoi field to its right. The band is rendered beneath deliberately, because the seam guarantee is not observable with nothing underneath and this shape has TWO figures that can each break it independently — both must sit ON the join rather than floating above it. The foot slot is filled for the same reason: the CTA has to sit inside the prose grid, or the band is pushed down and both figures end in mid-air. The prose is deliberately short so min-height sets the block's height rather than the copy.
